description: ffr.v1 model -> modelFamily lookup. EXACT model ids only: a model id absent from `models` maps to `unknown`, never to a guessed family (no prefix or substring matching). Harness names (cursor-agent, droid, odin-agent) are NOT models; they map to `unknown` because the underlying model is not recorded. Adding a model or a family is an additive data change and does not touch the frozen schema sha. Seeded 2026-10-01 from the model ids in .ai/routing-decisions.log and the local-MLX lanes (rule 31).
